subtasks.title: New HitPlateStatsBatchQuery — batched uniqExact(ocr) per month per hit_type from clarity.hits_cold
subtasks.approach: Add a ClickhouseQuery sibling to HitStatsBatchQuery that returns the DEDUPED plate count. Mirror HitStatsBatchQuery's public shape exactly (static handle() for the 13-month batch, static handleRange() for today/last_7d) and return the SAME four array keys (live_hit_count, historical_hit_count, staging_live_hit_count, staging_historical_hit_count) so SharedHitStatsData::getHitStatsColumn() indexes both maps with no branching. The only source that carries a plate is clarity.hits_cold (hit_stats_daily has no plate column); hits_cold is the FULL table (hits_hot is a 90-day TTL copy of the same schema — database/schema/clickhouse-schema.sql:129,131), so ONE cold query covers the whole 13-month window and no hot/cold seam is introduced. Org scoping is kit_org_id (F3/C4: hit_stats_daily.org_id is the kit org; org 165 — the largest hotlist_org_id — returns ZERO hit_stats_daily rows). No disposition filter (F9: the chlocal MV applies none). FINAL only — _peerdb_is_deleted is the native engine is-deleted arg (F7), so no extra WHERE. hit_type is enumerated explicitly as L/H/S/Z, which structurally excludes the undocumented 'F' (Missed_Opportunity_Historical, 34 rows) and M/P. TDD: write the test first.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
app/Clickhouse/Queries/HitPlateStatsBatchQuery.php (NEW, ~90 lines): `final class HitPlateStatsBatchQuery extends ClickhouseQuery` with `declare(strict_types=1)`.
  - `private const DATETIME_PATTERN = '/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$/';` — validate `start`/`end` with preg_match and throw InvalidArgumentException on mismatch (copy the guard idiom + comment from RdnHitHourCountQuery.php:11,25-30; addslashes is not a SQL escape). `org_id` is `(int)` cast.
  - `public static function handle(array $arguments = []): array` →
    SELECT toStartOfMonth(hit_created_at) AS month,
           uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'L') AS live_hit_count,
           uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'H') AS historical_hit_count,
           uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'S') AS staging_live_hit_count,
           uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'Z') AS staging_historical_hit_count
    FROM <clarityDb>.hits_cold FINAL
    WHERE kit_org_id = {orgId}
      AND hit_created_at >= toDateTime('{start}')
      AND hit_created_at <= toDateTime('{end}')
    GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
    Then `$result[date('Y-m', strtotime($row['month']))] = [ ...four (int) casts... ]` — byte-for-byte the same month-key derivation as HitStatsBatchQuery.php:34 so the two series land on identical keys.
  - `public static function handleRange(array $arguments = []): array` — the same SELECT without toStartOfMonth/GROUP BY; returns the four keys as a flat array, with the `empty($rows)` zero-fill guard copied from HitStatsBatchQuery.php:69-76.
  - Table prefix via `static::clarityDb()` (ClickhouseQuery.php:102) rather than a hardcoded `clarity.` — required for the per-worktree local-CH QA databases. `DB::connection('clarity_clickhouse')->select($sql)`.
  - Docblock states, in one short paragraph: this is the ONLY plate-carrying source; uniqExact is mandatory and bare count() is forbidden here (F15 — FINAL cannot collapse rows whose sort key differs and the key contains the mutable hit_created_at, so raw counts run up to ~30% high; uniqExact(ocr) is immune because the duplicate rows carry the same ocr); kit_org_id is deliberate; no validDisposition().

tests/Feature/Clickhouse/HitPlateStatsBatchQueryTest.php (NEW): PHPUnit, `#[Group('clickhouse')]`, `use RequiresClickhouse` + `setupRequiresClickhouse()` in setUp — model the file on tests/Feature/Clickhouse/HitStatsBatchQueryTest.php. Seed with a private helper doing `DB::connection('clarity_clickhouse')->table('clarity.hits_cold')->insert([...])`, using the column set at tests/Feature/ClarityScout/HitDirectHotspotQueryTest.php:172-192 plus an explicit `id`. Freeze time with Carbon::setTestNow and clear it in tearDown. Four assertions:
  1. dedup collapses within a month — 3 rows, ocr 'AAA1111','AAA1111','BBB2222', same month, hit_type 'L' → live_hit_count === 2 (a count() implementation returns 3 and fails).
  2. months do NOT collapse into each other — the SAME ocr in two different months returns 1 for EACH month key, and the two month keys are both present.
  3. kit_org_id scoping — seed one row with kit_org_id=ORG/hotlist_org_id=OTHER and one with kit_org_id=OTHER/hotlist_org_id=ORG; querying ORG must return only the first (this is the assertion that fails if a worker reaches for scopeForOrg/hotlist_org_id).
  4. FINAL/ReplacingMergeTree — two rows with the same `id` and different `_version`, and one row with `_peerdb_is_deleted = 1`, must not double-count or count the deleted row.
  Plus one hit_type-isolation assertion: an 'F'-type row (and an 'M'/'P') must land in NONE of the four buckets.
  Note in the test docblock that hits_cold has NO TTL (only hits_hot does), so fixtures need not be anchored to now(); they are anchored to a frozen now() anyway for determinism.

subtasks.title: SharedHitStatsData data layer — resolve the unique series on its OWN cache keys and flip getCardTotal() to it
subtasks.approach: Thread the dedup series through SharedHitStatsData using the identical batching/caching discipline the total path already uses, but under a strictly separate cache-key namespace and separate static memos. This is the DEV-2324 constraint (DashboardWidget.php:330-338): one method, one cache key, two consumers — two independent series may NEVER write into each other's keys. Then override getCardTotal() so the tile headline becomes the deduped count (AC-1) and add getTotalHitCount() exposing the previous total for AC-2. Because the base toStat() (DashboardWidget.php:287-295) already renders getCardTotal(), AC-1 lands here with no presentation change. getDescription() in the trait switches to the unique series (AC-5). Trait methods take precedence over methods inherited from the parent class — the trait already relies on this for getMonthlyData()/getDescription()/getRangeTotal(), so the override mechanism is proven in this exact file.

subtasks.approach: Land AC-2/3/4 entirely inside SharedHitStatsData so nothing reaches ScanCount or RecoveryCounts. All three overrides go in the trait, never on the DashboardWidget base class and never on the shared vendor stat.blade.php: the base $options and getData() are shared by six widgets (F6), and Stat::description() already renders in the small fi-wi-stats-overview-stat-description slot (stat.blade.php:75-78, precedent KitUsers.php:59).
